script.title: The Octopus Has Three Hearts, And That's Not The Strangest Part

hook.text: This animal has three hearts and blue blood.

beats.text: Two hearts pump blood through its gills. A third one sends it around the rest of the body.
And when the octopus swims, that main heart actually stops beating. So it prefers crawling.
Its blood is blue because it carries oxygen with copper instead of iron.
It is also a master of disguise, changing colour and texture to vanish into the seabed.

payoff.text: Nature built an entire alien body plan, right here on Earth.
